values.note: $27 a night for a water/electric RV site, $35 for the six lakeside 'WF' sites with sewer (40-45); tent sites $23. One rate for everyone. Stays capped at 7 nights in 30 on waterfront/full-hookup sites, 14 on water/electric sites. Online bookings are paid up front; cancel 48 hours ahead for a refund.
